requirement: Speed up a Playwright suite by logging in once, saving the context's storage state to a file, and reusing it for new contexts until it is an hour old.
skeleton: An authenticated_context function that reuses a fresh state file via new_context(storage_state=...), otherwise logs in on a new context inside try, saves storage_state(path=...), and closes on failure.
caption: A Playwright helper, written in the standard library against a duck-typed browser and context with no third-party imports, that logs in once and reuses the saved storage state. authenticated_context(browser, state_path, login, *, max_age=3600.0, now=time.time) returns browser.new_context with storage_state set to the path when the file exists and its modification time is younger than max_age. Otherwise it creates a plain context and, inside a try block, calls login on a new page and saves context.storage_state with the path; any exception closes the context and re-raises. It returns the context. The fixture asserts that the first call logs in and writes the state file, that fresh state is reused without logging in, that state exactly max_age old is refreshed, and that a failed login closes the context and writes nothing.

plan.intent: Avoid logging in through the UI in every test
constraints: A state file younger than max_age is passed to new_context
A missing or stale file triggers login and storage_state(path=...)
State exactly max_age old is refreshed
A failing login closes the context and re-raises

rationale.teaches: Check existence and age with st_mtime against an injected clock, reuse via storage_state, and save or close in a try block.
rationale.why: Checking age without existence crashes the first run, storage_state without a path never writes the file, and a failed login leaks a browser context per test.

ops.docstring: Log in once and reuse a saved Playwright storage_state while it is fresh.

candidates.why_wrong: State exactly max_age old is reused instead of refreshed.
The first run crashes with FileNotFoundError before any state exists.
A failed login leaves its browser context open.
storage_state is called without a path, so nothing is saved.
The fresh state file is ignored and the context starts logged out.
